name: Custom Search Box
author: ideasToCode

sections.description:
Check Our Another Plugin

  • Improve WordPress Security | Live Preview
  • Enable SVG, WebP, and ICO Upload | Live Preview
  • Disable Auto-Update Emails and Block Updates for Plugins, WP Core, and Themes | Live Preview
  • Duplicate Page or Post, Delete Revisions and Enable Classic Editor | Live Preview

With this plugin, you can add a customized Search Box. Instead of using the theme defaults, you can simply use this plugin and add a search word with corresponding links so that only those searches will appear in the search box, and not other unnecessary contents of the website. This way, the user will only find the items you want them to find.

If you want to learn more about the plugin, please check our website – ideastocode.com.
sections.installation:
WP Custom Search Box can be directly installed from your website.

  1. Log in to your site’s dashboard (i.e. /wp-admin).
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for WP Custom Search Box or ideasToCode.
  4. Locate the plugin Custom Search Box & click on Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin → Navigate to Settings.
sections.faq:
How to use this plugin?

This plugin is very easy to use. Simply go to any page or post and add the shortcode [itc_csbp_custom_search], and it will display a search box. In the backend, go to the settings page to add the searchable name and links in the format Name | https://…url or Name | https://…url | _n (for opening in New Tab). You can also customize the search box using the Customize tab and adding values.

How to use the import/export settings?

With the import/export settings, you can export the settings from one website and import them to another, meaning you do not have to customize it again. All the search contents will also be transferred or restored.

Can Custom Search Box be used with all themes?

Yes, you can use this plugin with any theme. However, you will need to make adjustments with the CSS or customize it to make it appear and match with the theme.
